journeys.name: Create a new employer account
journeys.description: The user creates a new employer account by completing all tasks in the account creation task list.

journeys.name: Set or change employer account name
journeys.description: The user sets or updates their employer account name during account management or creation.

journeys.name: Remove an organisation from account agreements
journeys.description: The user confirms and completes the removal of an organisation from their account agreements.

journeys.name: Manage PAYE schemes
journeys.description: The user manages PAYE schemes for their employer account, including confirming, viewing details, and removing a scheme.

journeys.name: Manage employer team members
journeys.description: The user manages team members of their employer account, including inviting, reviewing, removing, and changing roles.

journeys.name: Invite a team member
journeys.description: The user invites a new team member and completes the invitation process.

journeys.name: Review and change a team member's role
journeys.description: The user reviews a team member and proceeds to update their role.

journeys.name: Remove a team member
journeys.description: The user removes a team member from their employer account.
